name: The Royal Cake
source:
In the Wonder Garden, a young goddess and princess desires her mother's royal cake. And today, she will have it!

A short comedy about a family of gods and the importance of cake.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/the-royal-cake]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在奇幻花园里，一位年轻的女神公主想要母亲做的皇家蛋糕。今天，她就要吃到它！

这是一个关于神明一家，以及蛋糕有多重要的短篇喜剧。

[来源：[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/the-royal-cake]Itch.io[/url]]
